category_title: Students with blindness and autism sensitive to environmental noise and tactile distractors
scenario_title: Focusing on academic tasks in a noisy classroom environment
minimal_context: The student is attempting to complete an academic task using separate materials while seated in a large, noisy regular classroom.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Here are your separate materials for the assignment. The rest of the class is starting their group discussions now, so you can begin working on this.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Please don't make a big deal out of giving me separate materials in front of everyone else.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Alright, just try to focus on your work while the other groups talk.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: There are too many things going on in here right now and the other students are disturbing me.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Keep trying to concentrate on the task in front of you.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I can't sort out all this noise. If it’s not calm, sensible and quiet, I just cannot think!

task.content: trying to focus on a task

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: distracting noise, when many things were going on or when other students disturbed them
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: expressed that they just cannot think
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: difficulties in sorting out stimuli, making it hard to concentrate
related_quotes: If it’s not calm, sensible and quiet, I just cannot think!

behavior_patterns.condition: teachers pointed them out, for example by making a big deal out of giving them separate materials or special treatment in front of the peers
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: resisted when teachers pointed them out
behavior_patterns.internal_state: felt a relief to be with others who also needed extra support
related_quotes: I like to be with other students who also need extra help, we understand each-other better. It feels good that I am not the only one.
